definition_en: an army officer of high rank, commanding a brigade, just below a major general
core_image: 肩上一颗星，身后一整旅士兵
scene: 阅兵场上，军官迈步走过队列，肩章在阳光下发亮。The brigadier inspected the parade before the review began.
sceneCN: 这里 brigadier 是「准将、旅长」（第 1 个义项：指挥一旅部队的高级军官）；句意是检阅开始前准将视察受阅部队。

derivatives.zh: brigadier 的基础词，义为「旅；队」
复合词，义为「准将」（美军称谓）
由 brigadier 加 -ship 构成，义为「准将职位（罕用）」

senses.title: A general officer commanding a brigade
senses.definition: a senior army officer who commands a brigade, ranking just below a major general
senses.definitionCN: 指挥一个旅的高级军官，军衔仅低于少将
senses.example: The brigadier ordered the battalion to hold the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 准将命令该营守住山脊。
senses.why: The title simply names the officer of a brigade, built on brigade.
senses.whyCN: 军衔名直接建立在 brigade（旅）之上：指挥一旅者即 brigadier。

senses.title: The rank itself
senses.definition: the military rank between colonel and major general
senses.definitionCN: 位于上校与少将之间的军衔等级
senses.example: He retired with the rank of brigadier.
senses.why: Once the officer is named by the unit, the name extends to the rank itself.
senses.whyCN: 既以部队命名军官，官名便转指军衔本身。

senses.title: Head of certain police or fire units
senses.titleCN: （某些国家的）警察或消防分队长
senses.definition: in some countries, an officer in charge of a police or fire brigade unit
senses.definitionCN: 在部分国家，指警队或消防队某分队的指挥官
senses.example: A fire brigadier coordinated the evening shift.
senses.exampleCN: 消防分队长协调晚班调度。
senses.why: Brigade also names non-military squads, so their leaders borrow the title.
senses.whyCN: brigade 亦指非军事的队伍，其长官便借用这一头衔。

intro.en: Brigadier comes from brigade, an Italian military word carried through French.
intro.cn: brigadier 源自 brigade，后者是经法语传入的意大利军事用语。

items.en: brigata meant a company or troop, from brigare, to fight or band together.
items.cn: 意大利语 brigata 指队伍，源自 brigare（结伙、争斗）。

items.en: brigade was adopted for a large military unit; brigadier named its commander.
items.cn: 法语借入 brigade 指大型作战单位，brigadier 指其指挥官。

items.en: English took brigade and brigadier in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语于十七世纪借入 brigade 与 brigadier。

items.en: brigadier general settled as a rank in British and American usage.
items.cn: 英美军制中 brigadier general 固定为正式军衔。

items.en: British usage says brigadier; American usage says brigadier general.
items.cn: 英式称 brigadier，美式称 brigadier general。

note.en: Brigadier belongs to a ladder of rank titles built on unit names.
note.cn: brigadier 与一组由部队单位名构成的军衔词同场出现。

entries.definition: a large military unit; the base word of brigadier
the American title for the same rank
a bandit; shares the Italian root brigare
entries.definitionCN: 土匪；与 brigadier 同出意大利语 brigare（结伙）

entries.definition: an officer in charge of a unit
a person holding a position of authority in the forces

normalIntro.en: Build brigadier from brigade plus -ier, the man of the brigade.
normalIntro.cn: 把 brigadier 拆成 brigade 加 -ier：指挥一旅之人。

normal.en: Brigadier is brigade plus -ier, like banker from bank.
normal.cn: brigadier 等于 brigade 加 -ier，如 banker 之于 bank。

normal.en: Brigand and brigade share the root brigare, to band together.
normal.cn: brigand 与 brigade 同根 brigare（结伙），一伙当兵、一伙落草。

normal.en: One star on the shoulder, one brigade behind.
normal.cn: 肩上一颗星，身后一整旅。

normal.en: Colonel up, brigadier above him, major general higher.
normal.cn: 上校之下，准将居中，少将更高。

normal.en: Fire brigades have brigadiers too in some countries.
normal.cn: 某些国家消防队也有 brigadier（分队长）。

abstract.en: See medals glint as the brigadier walks the line.
abstract.cn: 想象准将走过队列时勋章闪光。

abstract.en: Hear a single command roll across the parade ground.
abstract.cn: 听一声口令滚过阅兵场。

abstract.en: Feel the weight of a whole brigade moving at one word.
abstract.cn: 感受一整旅人随一声令下齐动的分量。

examples.en: The brigadier briefed the officers before dawn.
examples.cn: 准将在拂晓前向军官们布置任务。

examples.en: She was promoted to brigadier after twenty years of service.
examples.cn: 服役二十年后她晋升为准将。

examples.en: A police brigadier addressed the crowd through a loudspeaker.
examples.cn: 一名警队分队长用扩音器向人群喊话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不日格带」——准将「不日」就要视查，身后「格」外齐整的部队被他一「带」。

root: brigadier 由法语 brigade（旅）加 -ier（从事者）构成；brigade 源自意大利语 brigata（队伍），其词根 brigare（结伙）一般认为与意语 briga（争吵、纠纷）相关，更早来源存疑。

sensesIntro.en: From commander of a brigade, the word widens to the rank and to some civil unit leaders.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「一旅之长」出发，扩展为军衔本身，再借给某些民事分队的主官。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one officer speaking, a whole brigade listening.
core.cn: 核心意象：一名军官发令，一整旅人聆听。

intro.en: The family is built on brigade with agent and rank suffixes.
intro.cn: 词族以 brigade 为基，加施动者与军衔后缀。

latinIntro.en: The trail leads back to Italian, not to classical Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 词源上溯至意大利语，而非古典拉丁语。
